verdict.rationale: Gram's Control Plane generates a hosted MCP server directly from an OpenAPI document or a TypeScript Functions project, with no protocol plumbing required from the developer, and a CLI/runtime probe confirms the tooling actually installs and runs. missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on account of the OpenAPI-to-MCP generation flow itself, and more detail on custom-code/TypeScript function support beyond the docs mention.
